integrity: The proof uses the published SDE drift, the published Section 6.1 Milstein formula, the article's later ANN Euler formula, exact symbolic cancellation, and an exact rational witness. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns the equations printed in the 2026 article. It does not inspect unpublished implementation code, rerun the published figures, or quantify full-trajectory numerical bias.
title: A spurious incidence sink makes the printed Milstein measles scheme drift-inconsistent
